Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished…
I arose in the night, I and a few men with me. I didn’t tell anyone what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem.…
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no…
Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: Then the heads of fathers’ households of Judah and Benjamin, the priests, and the Levites, all whose spirit God had stirred to go up rose up to build Yahweh’s house which is in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: So the family heads of Judah and Benjamin, along with the priests and Levites—everyone whose spirit God had stirred—prepared to go up and rebuild the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: Then rose up the heads of fathers' houses of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, even all whose spirit God had stirred to go up to build the house of Jehovah which is in Jerusalem.
